people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

translations.web: All the cities which you shall give to the Levites shall be forty-eight cities together with their pasture lands.
translations.bsb: The total number of cities you give the Levites will be forty-eight, with their corresponding pasturelands.
translations.kjv: So all the cities which ye shall give to the Levites shall be forty and eight cities: them shall ye give with their suburbs.
translations.asv: All the cities which ye shall give to the Levites shall be forty and eight cities; them shall ye give with their suburbs.
